- [LLOG.11.2] **Tick-based re-evaluation for time-bound LHS tests.** The
  engine re-evaluates every time-dependent test at each pump, under that
  pump's clock sample ([LTIM.2.8.4]). A match the new sample refuses ends,
  and the logical facts it justified are retracted ([LTIM.2.5.1],
  [LTIM.2.7.2]). Resolution is one pump: the integrator's pump cadence
  decides it, and the engine has no tick interval of its own.
  Restates [LTIM.2.5.1].
